title: Final Energy Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The final energy stored in the capacitor must be correctly calculated and presented.

title: Voltage Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The voltage across the 3 μF capacitor must be accurately derived from the circuit analysis.

title: Capacitance Value
description: Essential Criteria: The capacitance value of 3 μF must be correctly identified and used in the energy formula.

title: Energy Formula Usage
description: Important Criteria: The correct formula for energy stored in a capacitor must be applied appropriately.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Units must be consistent throughout the calculations, particularly for voltage and energy.

title: Common Calculation Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Watch for common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect application of the formula.
